# Psalm 111 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! I-will-give-thanks to-YHWH with-all the-heart, in-council-of the-upright and-assembly.

**2** Great the-works-of YHWH, sought-out by-all delighting in-them.

**3** Splendor and-majesty his-work, and-his-righteousness stands to-forever.

**4** A-memorial he-has-made for-his-wonders; gracious and-compassionate YHWH.

**5** Food he-has-given to-those-fearing-him; he-remembers to-forever his-covenant.

**6** The-power-of his-works he-has-declared to-his-people, to-give to-them the-inheritance-of nations.

**7** The-works-of his-hands faithfulness and-justice; trustworthy all his-precepts,

**8** Upheld to-forever and-ever, done in-truth and-uprightness.

**9** Redemption he-has-sent to-his-people; he-has-commanded to-forever his-covenant; holy and-fearsome his-name.

**10** The-beginning-of wisdom the-fear-of YHWH; understanding good to-all doing-them. His-praise stands to-forever.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **111:1-10**: An acrostic psalm — each half-verse begins with a successive letter of the Hebrew alphabet (aleph through tav).

- **111:10**: 'The-beginning-of wisdom the-fear-of YHWH' — the foundational wisdom saying, shared with Proverbs 9:10 and Job 28:28.

— EMET
